ARXML signal initial values not loaded correctly

When loading ARXML files, signal initial values are not being parsed correctly. The loader appears to be returning incorrect values or None instead of the actual initial values specified in the ARXML.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load an ARXML file with signal initial values
db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')

# Check a signal that should have an initial value
message = db.get_message_by_name('Message1')
signal = message.get_signal_by_name('signal1')

print(f"Expected initial value: 25")
print(f"Actual initial value: {signal.initial}")
```

The signal should have an initial value of 25 but returns None or an incorrect value instead.

This affects multiple signals across different ARXML files and appears to impact both direct initial value specifications and constant references.
